generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The contractor is responsible for any damages due to natural calamities. KOMUL will not give any compensation for until the completion of maintenance period

The amount put to tender is exclusive of GST. GST will be paid to the tendered amount separately as per prevailing rates. The contractor shall quote the rates excluding GST. The bidder shall study the Tender document carefully and quote the rates

The Tenderers shall obtain the work done certificate in the prescribed format from the competent Authority not below the Rank of Executive Engineer (District level Officer) and scan the original Certificate and attach the scanned file Certificate. Original Certificates shall be produced to the Managing Director KOMUL during technical evaluation
The defect liability period for the work is 12 (Twelve) calendar months from completion date of same work (Final bill date).
The measurements for recording bill will be taken jointly along with contractor and engineer in charge from KOMUL and the same shall be certified
